scripts.build: pnpm --filter @tnldotdev/dev build && pnpm --filter @tnldotdev/next build:self && pnpm --filter @tnldotdev/vite build:self
scripts.format: oxfmt --write package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.test.json vitest.config.ts 'packages/**/*.{json,md,ts,tsx}' 'scripts/*.mjs'
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml tsconfig.base.json tsconfig.test.json vitest.config.ts 'packages/**/*.{json,md,ts,tsx}' 'scripts/*.mjs'
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project packages/dev/type-test.tsconfig.json && tsc --project packages/next/type-test.tsconfig.json && tsc --project packages/vite/type-test.tsconfig.json && tsc --project tsconfig.test.json
